entry.title: On odd perfect numbers of special forms
entry.summary: We give necessary conditions for perfection of some families of odd numbers with special multiplicative forms. Extending earlier work of Steuerwald, Kanold, McDaniel et al.
entry.arxiv:comment: Paper published in Aportaciones Matematicas Investigacion 20 (2011) 109--115. No longer available over Internet

entry.title: Some multiplicative functions over $\mathbb{F}_2$
entry.summary: We adapt (over $\mathbb{F}_2$) the general notions of multiplicative function, Dirichlet convolution and Inverse. We get some interesting results, namely necessary conditions for an odd binary polynomial to be perfect. Note that we are inspired by the "analogous" works in \cite{Gall-Rahav-newcongr} and \cite{Touchard}, about odd perfect numbers.

entry.title: On bi-unitary perfect polynomials over $F_2$
entry.summary: We give all bi-unitary non splitting even perfect polynomials over the prime field of two elements, which are divisible by Mersenne irreducible polynomials raised to special exponents. We also identify all bi-unitary perfect polynomials over the same field, with at most four irreducible factors. We then complete, in this manner, a list given by J.T. B. Beard Jr.
entry.arxiv:comment: We get more general results in Theorem 1.1. Corollary 5.27 and Theorem 1.3 are false

entry.title: Admissible family for binary perfect polynomials
entry.summary: The paper is about an arithmetic problem in $\F_2[x]$. We give \emph{admissible} (necessary) conditions satisfied by a set of odd prime divisors of perfect polynomials over $\F_2$. This allows us to prove a new characterization of \emph{all} known perfect polynomials, and to open a way of finding more of them (if they exist).

entry.title: All even (unitary) perfect polynomials over $\F_2$ with only Mersenne primes as odd divisors
entry.summary: We address an arithmetic problem in the ring $\F_2[x]$ related to the fixed points of the sum of divisors function. We study some binary polynomials $A$ such that $σ(A)/A $ is still a binary polynomial. Technically, we prove that the only (unitary) perfect polynomials over $\F_2$ that are products of $x$, $x+1$ and of Mersenne primes are precisely the nine (resp. nine "classes") known ones. This follows from a new result about the factorization of $M^{2h+1} +1$, for a Mersenne prime $M$ and for a positive integer $h$.
entry.arxiv:comment: 16 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:1908.00106

entry.title: Factorization of cyclotomic polynomial values at Mersenne primes
entry.summary: We get some results about the factorization of $φ_p(M) \in {\mathbb{F}}_2[x]$, where $p$ is a prime number, $φ_p$ is the corresponding cyclotomic polynomial and $M$ is a Mersenne prime (polynomial). By the way, we better understand the factorization of the sum of the divisors of $M^{2h}$, for a positive integer $h$.

entry.title: On odd prime divisors of binary perfect polynomials
entry.summary: We give necessary conditions satisfied by the set of odd prime divisors of binary perfect polynomials. This allows us to get a new characterization of all the known perfect binary polynomials.

entry.title: On (unitary) perfect polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with only Mersenne primes as odd divisors
entry.summary: The only (unitary) perfect polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_2$ that are products of $x$, $x+1$ and Mersenne primes are precisely the nine (resp. nine "classes") known ones. This follows from a new result about the factorization of $M^{2h+1} +1$, for a Mersenne prime $M$ and for a positive integer $h$. Other consequences of such a factorization are new results about odd perfect polynomials.

entry.title: All unitary perfect polynomials over $F_2$ with less than five distinct prime factors
entry.summary: We find all unitary perfect polynomials over the prime field $\F_2$ with less than five distinct prime factors.
entry.arxiv:comment: revised version, report on preliminary version included

entry.title: On splitting perfect polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$
entry.summary: We study some properties of the exponents of the terms appearing in the splitting perfect polynomials over $\mathbb{F}_{p^2}$, where $p$ is a prime number. This generalizes the work of Beard et al. over $\mathbb{F}_p$. Corrected paper. Older Lemmas 2.17 to 2.20 in published version required a fixing done herein.

entry.title: Even perfect polynomials over $F_2$ with four prime factors
entry.summary: A perfect polynomial over the binary field $\F_2$ is a polynomial $A \in \F_2[x]$ that equals the sum of all its divisors. If $\gcd(A,x^2-x) \neq 1$ then we call $A$ even. The list of all even perfect polynomials over $\F_2$ with at most 3 prime factors in known. The object of this paper is to give the list of all even perfect polynomials over $\F_2$ with four prime factors. These are all the known perfect polynomials with four prime factors over $\F_2$.
